newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell three main units show profit gain.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell three main units show profit gain.

text.p: Honeywell Inc said Monday operating profits at its three main businesses rose during the second quarter, led by its space and aviation control unit.

The division reported operating profit of $61.8 million versus $44.4 million a year earlier, and sales rose to $488.8 million from $399.2 million in the second quarter of 1996. The gains were driven by strong commercial aviation performance. Total orders for the quarter were up seven percent.
Honeywell's industrial control division recorded operating profit of $67.5 million compared with $66.6 million a year earlier. Sales rose 20 percent to $667.3 million.
